operator-controlled release gate succeeds in the target environment.

## Release gate

Run `bun run release:gate` with the local PostgreSQL and Redis test services
available. CI additionally rebuilds from an empty database, checks migration
drift and generated artifacts, audits dependencies, produces an SBOM, scans the
container image, smoke-starts API/worker processes, and exercises graceful
shutdown. Provider health and backup/PITR restoration remain deployment-owner
acceptance gates because a source repository cannot prove external operations.
